title: From business need to evolved software
intro: A Pull Request is only one controlled delivery mechanism. The real Factory process is the reasoning and coordination that happens before the code is changed. Click through each step, or press play.

pipeline.title: The Factory pipeline
pipeline.intro: This is not one coding agent. It is a coordinated organization of specialized engineering agents.

steps.title: Business Need
steps.text: A company or product owner describes what the business needs, in plain language.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: Factory investigates the business and the existing ecosystem across every layer before proposing anything.

steps.title: Ecosystem Graph
steps.text: Factory builds the relationships between components, so it can reason about the impact of a change.

steps.title: Multi-Agent Reasoning
steps.text: Specialized agents analyze the need from their own domain, and a Decision Gate consolidates their reasoning.

steps.title: Engineering Plan
steps.text: Instead of changing code immediately, Factory produces an Agentic Engineering Work Plan that can be reviewed and approved.

steps.title: Controlled Execution
steps.text: Governed tools execute the approved plan across the repositories, in dependency order.

steps.title: Validate & Review
steps.text: Changes are validated, reviewed, fixed and re-tested until they meet the acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Deliver & Evolve
steps.text: The change is delivered as a controlled Pull Request that a human merges. Production learning then feeds the next evolution.
